predictions: I pretty clearly had a misnamed pick last week, as I noted the specific reasons why I was picking my team, but then just typed the opponents' name for some reason. The notes didn't match, so that pick was likely pretty confusing. (Note: my notes were spot on in the end, even if the typo wasn't.) In the end, my 19-6 record for the week was my best so far this season. That takes me to 168-82 (67.2% correct) for the season, which is still just pretty decent. I would be faring a lot better if I didn't have to pick F division matches… an incredibly weak 15-15 in F so far, although I have at least finally gotten a couple Cheap Shots picks right.

Match of the week: (D Div.) Menace 2 Sobriety @ Nine Lives. Area has walked away with the D crown, but the battle for 2nd (and likely a spot in C next season) is still very much alive. These two have the same record, so the winner here is immediately the favorite for that 2nd slot. I just can't pick the ever-shorthanded ones… Thus, Niners, 12-10.

Match #2: (F Div.) One Time @ Runs with Corks. Well, this is likely the last chance at there being a real race in F. If the Corks win this, they will have a three-match lead with only three to play. But if One Time wins this, the Corks' cushion would drop to about a single match. The Corks needed a tiebreaker last time… this time they escape 13-11.

Match #3: (B Div.) Buffalo Bulls @ Hump Day! Darty Minds still holds the B lead, but they are certainly still within reach. Hump Day is currently the team in 2nd, they took out Buffalo seven weeks ago, and they are closest to Darty. So, naturally, I will take Buffalo, 13-11.

Match #4: (C Div.) Big Duck Energy @ OnlyDarts. Both these teams sort of dropped opportunities last week, but they're also still both very much alive in the race for 2nd (and a likely climb to B). Only, 15-9.

Match #5: (A Div.) Consistently Inconsistent @ Dart Attack. The fight for a top-four-in-the-league spot rages on, here between last season's #4 and this season's current #4. Attack keeps their spot, 14-10.
Match #6: (B Div.) Darty Minds @ Liquor Possee. As we've noted all over this newsletter, every B match could be big in determining the season champ. Maybe Darty finally takes a little control, 14-10.
Match #7: (F Div.) Shark Shooters @ Rippin Darts. Four F teams are separated by only half a match, and one of them is going to end up with a bottom-two finish. The Shooters take it in a tiebreaker.

Matches #8 & #9: (D Div.) Breakfast Club @ One Armed Bandits; Main Street Mayhem @ Shooter McGavin. Some of the bottom four in D are still very much alive in the fight for 2nd. But all four also are definitely in the struggle to avoid those bottom two slots in D. Looks like the current higher-ranked team will win each of these… Bandits take it down, 14-10; and McGavin grabs a 15-9 victory.
Match #10: (B Div.) Kids On The Fringe @ Mulligans Mafia. Each and every B match could be huge in determining the season champ. I'm thinking the Kids finally eliminate the first B challenger, 14-10.
Match #11: (E Div.) That's What She Said @ Outlaw Arrows. The loser here might well be headed to F, while the winner might be in the fight to clime to D. Big stakes, man. The Arrows fly, 13-11.

Match #12: (H Div.) 21 Dart Salute @ Bright Side of Flights. The battle to avoid 'that spot' at the bottom of page 2 has become quite heated and crowded. Big one here. Let's go with the Salute, 13-11.
